description: Scrapes Zimuku / srtku.com for Chinese and English movie and episode subtitles. Includes native Yunsuo image verification, no-image coordinate fallback, optional helper fallback, and host-side extraction of ZIP archives or direct subtitle downloads. Multilingual RAR/7z archives are skipped, since they cannot be language-selected host-side.
name: Zimuku
